description: Run SwapChan's calldata guard + simulation on any unsigned tx and return a verdict (ok / caution / danger), findings, balance-diff simulation and a plain-language summary for human sign-off. Covers unlimited approvals, Permit2, setApprovalForAll, Safe DELEGATECALL, proxy upgrades, EIP-7702, ownership transfers, address poisoning lookalikes, minOut vs quote, Solana program allowlist + simulateTransaction, Tron AccountPermissionUpdate. Always show the summary to the human and get an explicit yes for THIS tx before their wallet signs. Trustless: read-only, never signs. Result includes `display` markdown with chan images: show it to the user. How to combine this with the other tools: swapchan_playbook (workflows: find-money, best-swap, rebalance, revoke-approvals, bridge-stuck, token-safety, recover-old-wallet).

chainId.description: Chain id (1, 8453, 42161, 10, 137, 56, 43114, 59144, 534352, 792703809 Solana, 8253038 Bitcoin, 728126428 Tron) or name (eth, base, arbitrum, optimism, polygon, bnb, avalanche, linea, scroll, solana, bitcoin, tron).

expected.description: expected.recipient and expected.minOut are checked against the simulated outcome (pass tx.from); if they cannot be checked, the verdict is danger.

outToken.description: Token whose simulated receipt must be >= minOut (default: largest receipt)

tx.description: EVM {from,to,data,value}, Solana base64 tx, or Tron tx JSON

name: verify_tx
title: Verify an unsigned transaction before signing
